claim: The set of tail names is not the same in the text as in the figures.
locus_A: SI section 1 names eight tails: O17O, O17S, O17Se, O18S-S, O16S-S, N16S-S, EC18, EC16.
locus_B: Figure S1 labels three tails that section 1 never names (O17C, O16B, N16B); Figure S4's lower legend lists O17C and O18S-S but NOT O16S-S (7 entries) while Figure S5's lower legend lists both (8 entries) for what is the same sub-library; O17Se is synthesised in section 1.3 and appears in no figure at all.
what_we_emitted: Only the five tails section 1 actually synthesises are built. O17C, O16B, N16B, O18S-S, EC18 and EC16 are listed in 01_blocks_qc.json as named-but-not-built.
why: A tail that is named in one place and specified in none cannot be drawn. Trap 5 and trap 7 both apply: the name fixes a chain length but not a linker.

claim: O16B / N16B are probably O16S-S / N16S-S under a second label, but it cannot be shown.
locus_A: Figure S1 panels are titled 9322-O16B and 9322-N16B.
locus_B: Figures S4 and S5 plot 9322 against O16S-S and N16S-S and never against an O16B. The chain-atom counts match (16 both ways) and 'B' plausibly abbreviates bisulfide.
what_we_emitted: Neither O16B nor N16B is built. D-3 stays OPEN. Figure S1's 9322-O16B and 9322-N16B panels were re-measured on 2026-11-10 with head 9322 in hand and BOTH REFUSED the tick-label calibration - O16B spacing nonuniformity 18.3 %, N16B never reaches 10 label boxes, against a 4 % criterion that was NOT loosened to recover them. Even had they calibrated, O16S-S and N16S-S differ by 1.97 Da = 0.5 px, which this axis cannot separate.
why: The predictions now exist - 9322-O16S-S [M+H]+ 804.487 and 9322-N16S-S 802.519 - and the first pass's rough glyph impressions of 804.84 and 800.82/802.82 sit beside them. That is suggestive and it is not a measurement, so it is recorded and not acted on.

claim: A lipidoid name appears once and nowhere else.
locus_A: SI section 7 (CCK-8 viability): 'FLuc mRNA loaded 93-S14 was delivered into T cells'.
locus_B: No figure, legend or other section in the SI uses the token S14. Figure S2b, which that section describes, plots 93-O17S.
what_we_emitted: Figure S2b's rows are recorded as 93-O17S with is_delivery_endpoint = 0 (viability is not emitted anyway).
why: Reported, not resolved. If S14 is a third naming dialect for the tetradecyl thioether tail it is consistent; if it is a different compound the viability panel belongs to a different molecule.

claim: The chosen formulation is not the best one in the panel cited for choosing it.
locus_A: SI section 2: '16: 4: 1: 1 (Lipidoid: cholesterol: DOPE: DSPE-PEG) w/w ratio was chosen (Figure S2a, SI)'.
locus_B: In Figure S2a the 16:4:1:0 bar is the panel maximum at 6177.7 RLU against 5078.8 RLU for 16:4:1:1 -- a factor of 1.216, and the two error bars do not overlap.
what_we_emitted: Both ratios are emitted as their own rows with their own measured values. Nothing is reconciled.
why: Dropping DSPE-PEG entirely would be expected to hurt colloidal stability, so choosing the second-best bar is defensible -- but the SI states the choice as if the panel supported it, and it does not.

claim: The CCK-8 incubation time is given twice, differently.
locus_A: Figure S2 caption: 'CCK-8 assay of CD8+ T lymphocytes cultured for 6 h after treated with FLuc mRNA loaded 93-O17S dose dependently'.
locus_B: SI section 7: 'T cells were cultured at 37 C for 7 or 21 h, followed by the treatment with 10 uL CCK-8 solution ... then cultured for additional 4 h'.
what_we_emitted: The Figure S2b rows carry both statements in their timepoint field.
why: Not a delivery value, so it changes nothing we emit; recorded because it bears on C-03, which is the same sentence.

claim: The screening dose and the optimised dose disagree inside one paragraph.
locus_A: SI section 6: 'LNP/mRNA complex was added into cell culture medium at a final concentration of 1.7 ug/mL and 17 ug/mL, respectively' (mRNA and lipidoid).
locus_B: The next sentence of the same section: 'The best delivery time and lipidoid concentration was found to be ~6 h and 30 ug/mL, respectively (Figure S2c,d)'.
what_we_emitted: Dose_ug_nucleicacid is left BLANK on all 13 emitted rows. Figure S2a does not state its own dose and the two candidates differ by 1.76x.
why: Trap: a dose that is stated twice in one paragraph with two values is not recoverable by picking one. F-004's N:P is the precedent.

claim: A reagent quantity implies the wrong molar mass by 8.2 %, in the section that defines the O17 tails' chain length.
locus_B: 1-bromotetradecane is 277.29 g/mol. SI 1.2 gives '1-bromotetradecane (5.0 g, 18 mmol)' = 277.8 g/mol, 0.18 % off.
what_we_emitted: C14. The intermediate in the same paragraph, '(3.3 g, 12.8 mmol)' = 257.81 g/mol against 2-(tetradecyloxy)ethanol at 258.45, 0.25 %.
why: See 08_retracted_suspicions.csv R-04: 6.0 g / 20 mmol fits 1-bromohexadecane (305.3, 1.7 %) BETTER than tetradecane, and that near miss is why the chain is taken from the intermediate and not from the starting material.

claim: Two reagent quantities in SI 1.4 imply wrong molar masses, one by 34.8 %.
locus_A: SI 1.4: '2',2'-Dipyridyl disulfide (4.00 g, 13.47 mmol)' implies 296.96 g/mol against a true 220.32; '1-Dodecanol (2.00 g, 11.23 mmol)' implies 178.09 against 186.34.
locus_B: The intermediate in the same paragraph, '(2.00 g, 6.43 mmol)' = 311.04 g/mol against dodecyl 2-pyridyl disulfide at 311.56 -- 0.17 %.
what_we_emitted: C12 for the 16S-S tails, from the intermediate.
why: Same shape as C-07: the starting-material lines are unreliable in this SI and the intermediate lines are exact. 16 of 18 ladder rows pass at 5 %; the two failures are both starting materials.

claim: Three different dose ladders are called the same thing.
locus_A: Figure S2b x axis: 6, 15, 30, 45, 60 ug/mL 'Lipidoid concentration'.
what_we_emitted: Each panel's own ladder, per row.
why: Not an error, but it means no two of these panels can be aligned dose-for-dose, which matters if anyone later tries to pool them.

claim: The library is not a full factorial and nowhere says so.
locus_A: Figures S4 and S5 top panels plot 18 heads against 3 tails, but many head x tail cells have no bar at all (e.g. 9316 has only O17O; 93 has only O17S in Figure S4 top).
locus_B: The text never states a library size, a design, or which combinations were made.
what_we_emitted: Nothing -- no library member is emitted.
why: Recorded because 'N heads x M tails' would be the natural assumption and it is wrong. Trap 1: distinct structures, formulations and individually measured are three different numbers, and here none of the three is stated.
